question: What was the tenure of Gopal Swarup Pathak as a Vice President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1969 - 1974**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• He was Vice President of India during **1969 - 1974**.
 
• He was the** first Vice President **who **did not become President **in pursuance of his senior President.
 
• He was a distinguished judge in the **Allahabad High Court**.
 
• He has been a** member of the Rajya Sabha** as well as the **Union Law Minister**.
 
• Apart from this, he was also the **Governor of Karnataka**.
 
• He received spiritual knowledge from **Swami Ramtirtha** and **Sadhuvaswani**.
 
• The then Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru included him in the** Indian delegation to the United Nations**.
 
• Equal opportunity to all, justice to all, this was his belief.
 
• In the** year 1959**, he collaborated with** V K Krishna Menon **in establishing the **Indian Society for International Law**.
 
• He said that Parliament is at the center of constitutional structures, Parliament is the most powerful medium for economic and social justice of the people, problems can be solved in a constitutional way.
